description: Defines configuration, interface, and class for DPDK-based hardware-accelerated baseband device (bbdev) in the ocudu project, including constants, configuration struct, and bbdev_acc class with methods for resource management and device info.

classes.name: bbdev_acc
classes.description: Represents a DPDK-based hardware-accelerated baseband device, managing device info, queues, and resource reservation.

methods.name: get_device_id
methods.description: Returns the device ID of the bbdev device.

methods.name: get_socket_id
methods.description: Returns the socket ID used by the device.

methods.name: get_nof_ldpc_enc_cores
methods.description: Returns the number of LDPC encoder cores.

methods.name: get_nof_ldpc_dec_cores
methods.description: Returns the number of LDPC decoder cores.

methods.name: get_nof_fft_cores
methods.description: Returns the number of FFT cores.

methods.name: get_harq_buff_size_bytes
methods.description: Returns the HARQ buffer size in bytes.

methods.name: get_msg_mbuf_size
methods.description: Returns the size of mbufs for unencoded/unrate-matched messages.

methods.name: get_rm_mbuf_size
methods.description: Returns the size of mbufs for encoded/rate-matched messages.

methods.name: get_nof_mbuf
methods.description: Returns the number of mbufs in each pool.

methods.name: reserve_queue
methods.description: Reserves a queue for a specific operation type.
